verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents role-based sharing: Shares grant read access to users or roles, and preset roles such as Explorer can be used to isolate tenants. An include pattern limits which tables and views a Share exposes, giving table-level scoping. Nothing in the evidence covers column-level grants, row-level security, or masking policies, which are core to the story. missing for 10: column-level access control, row-level security policies, data masking policies, custom role definition/grant model beyond preset roles and shares, independent corroboration
